{"thought": "orders 表有 channel 欄位可能是通路，先查 channel 的實際值與 status 分布，確認「官網」對應的代碼。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT channel, status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY channel, status ORDER BY channel, status"}}

{"thought": "「官網」在語意層無對應，從 channel 的值推測為 web，但需先確認 order_ts 的時間格式，才能正確篩出 2025 年第一季。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT order_id, order_ts, status, channel FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 10"}}

{"thought": "語意層定義取消率為已取消（status 9）÷（狀態 1、2、3、9 的訂單數），待付款（0）不入分母；以 channel='web' 代表官網，期間以 order_ts 落在 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31 為準。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN order_id END) AS cancelled, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN order_id END) AS denom, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN order_id END), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE channel = 'web' AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < '2025-04-01 00:00:00'"}}

response: {"thought": "取消率定義與分母規則已由語意層確認，SQL 結果為 1191 ÷ 7083 = 16.81，可交付。", "tool": "submit_answer", "args": {"answer": "16.81", "basis": "依語意層「取消率」定義：已取消訂單（status=9）÷（狀態 1、2、3、9 的不重複訂單數），待付款（status=0）不入分母。「官網通路」語意層無對應項目，以 orders.channel='web' 代表官網；期間以 order_ts 落在 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31 歸屬。結果為已取消 1191 筆、分母 7083 筆。假設 order_ts 已是台北時間，因資料表未提供時區資訊。"}}
